name: wasm_eval
description: Compile and run a pure WAT WebAssembly module with no host imports. The module receives input bytes at offset 0 and exports run(ptr,len) -> (out_ptr<<32)|out_len; output is read at out_ptr. Use it to write small parsers or computations on demand. No filesystem, network, envd or host calls are available.

wat.description: WebAssembly text module (1-64 KiB) exporting memory and run(ptr,len)->i64. Imports are rejected.

input_base64.description: Optional input bytes, at most 64 KiB, written at offset 0 before run is called.
